blockers.what: Bar bar tomato ka rate aa raha tha, gehu ka nahi - query parameter kaise lagate hain samajh nahi aaya.
blockers.evidence: SEARCH: 'Baar baar tomato ka rate aa raha hai, mujhe Anand ka gehu ka rate chahiye. Endpoint ke query params dekhne hain.'

blockers.what: /v1/mandi/prices endpoint mein sahi params (mandi, commodity, date) ka pata nahi chala, isliye 14 baar bhi call karne par Anand wheat price nahi mila.
blockers.evidence: SEARCH: 'Anand ka mandi id aur price API ke query params jaanana hai, taaki sahi tarah se ghehu ka rate check kar saku.'

blockers.what: Mandi list se Anand APMC ka sahi mandi ID nahi mila, baar baar /v1/mandi/list call karna pada.
blockers.evidence: GET /v1/mandi/list expected 'Anand APMC ka mandi ID milega taaki wheat price check kar saku.'

blockers.what: Koi lot create nahi ho saka aur koi offer bhi nahi aaya, kyunki pehla step hi mandi price check karna adhura reh gaya.
blockers.evidence: Trace mein koi POST /lots ya offer related call nahi hai.

missing_features: Hinglish mein endpoint ke required query params batane wali help ya auto-suggest
Mandi name 'Anand' type karte hi matching mandi ID dikhana
Commodity 'gehu' ya 'wheat' select karne ka simple dropdown
Galat params par bhi sahi example wala error message
confusing: /v1/mandi/prices baar baar same tarah se call kiya bina params badle, har baar alag expectation rakhi
Prices aur list endpoints ke beech baar baar switch kiya, pata nahi chala pehle kya karna chahiye
SEARCH kabhi 200 deta hai toh kabhi 0, samajh nahi aaya ki search kaise kaam karta hai
unnecessary: /v1/mandi/prices ko 14 alag-alag steps mein bina sahi params ke repeat karna
/v1/mandi/list ko 6 baar baar call karna jabki ek baar mein hi list mil sakti thi
Same 'tomato aata hai' problem ko 2-3 baar search karke duplicate complaint karna
verbatim_frustration: Bhai, baar baar tamatar ka daam dikhata raha, mujhe toh Anand ka gehu bechna tha, param samajh nahi aaya toh lot banane tak kabhi pahuncha hi nahi!
